about.text: Scamorza is an Italian stretched-curd cheese from southern Italy, made from cow's milk (in Bari also sheep's). It is hung tied by a string, which gives it a pear shape, and is also sold smoked (affumicata).

facts.v: Curd stretched in hot water, tied, cooled and brined, dried in a cellar, aged one week to a month
Fresh curd rests in whey for hours to build acidity before shaping
